resources.string: USB frame test ended. Save a diagnostic report.

The USB connection could not start, so an automatic NCM frame test was attempted. Save a diagnostic report to check received frames, USB writes and matching probe replies. Unplug and reconnect the USB cable before trying again; testing may detach the system NCM driver. No VPN permission or root is required.

The iPhone USB network is not ready or the phone did not connect to AirPlay. Unplug and reconnect the USB data cable, then save a diagnostic report if it still fails. This connection uses the system USB network and does not require VPN permission or root.
